conflict: This Listing change conflicts with its recorded result. It was not sent again.
outcome.error: failed safely, will not send again
reenter: No result is recorded. Re-enter the same details to retry this attempt; changed details will not be sent.
confirming: Confirming the result of your Listing change.
failed_safe: The change was not sent. Review your inputs before trying again.
ambiguous: We could not confirm the result. Changes are disabled to avoid duplicating your work.
partial: {succeeded} of {total} Listings changed. Retry sends only the Listings whose result is unknown.
attempt_invalid: This change is missing its attempt identity. Reload and try again.
attempt_conflict: This change was already sent with different details. Reload to see the first result.
